title: Archive
subtitle: Student records from previous years.
upload_hint: Download the template, fill it in and upload it. Each row is linked to a student by CPR, then student number, then full name with the birth date when given. Rows with errors are skipped.
batch_delete_confirm: Delete this batch and all its archive records? No student is deleted.
search: Search by name, CPR or student number
history_unmatched: This record is not linked to a student; records with the same CPR or name are shown.
